themes_detail.label: Park Noise Crisis Emerges
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from parks in CD107 spiked to 6 this week versus a baseline of 0.4 complaints per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 1500% increase—suggesting a sudden, concentrated disturbance pattern that demands immediate investigation into what is driving complaints in what should be recreational spaces.
evidence: 6 park noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1500% spike, z-score 8.08)
This is the single most dramatic percentage increase in the dataset
No recent Reddit or community board discussion yet, suggesting a very recent onset
reporting_angles: What changed in Upper West Side parks this week? (events, construction, enforcement withdrawal, new activity?)
Interview park-goers and residents near major parks (Central Park perimeter, Riverside Park) about noise disturbances

themes_detail.label: Street Deterioration Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints jumped to 121 this week—a 244% increase from the 35.1-complaint weekly average—indicating rapid pavement or infrastructure degradation across CD107 that could pose safety risks and require urgent DOT intervention.
evidence: 121 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 35.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (244% spike, z-score 4.11)
Street Condition is already the 5th-highest complaint category overall (855 complaints in 90 days)
Pattern suggests systemic failure, not isolated incidents
reporting_angles: Map the 121 complaints this week—are they clustered geographically? (e.g., West Side Highway, Broadway, residential blocks?)
Interview DOT about current street maintenance schedule and whether this week's spike aligns with winter weather, budget constraints, or staffing gaps

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Dining Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Outdoor dining complaints skyrocketed to 11 last week—a 529% increase from the 1.8-complaint weekly average—raising questions about whether temporary dining sheds are creating quality-of-life conflicts around sanitation, noise, or structural safety.
evidence: 11 outdoor dining complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (529% spike, z-score 4.52)
Complaints are likely tied to persistent pandemic-era outdoor dining infrastructure still in place
Aligns with long-standing community board requests for expanded code enforcement (Buildings Department)
reporting_angles: Which restaurants/blocks are generating the most complaints? Are complaints about sheds blocking sidewalks, noise, waste, or safety?
Interview Buildings Department about enforcement of outdoor dining compliance; review whether the city is adequately monitoring these structures post-pandemic

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retail Complaints Jump
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints spiked to 4 last week—a 967% increase from the 0.4-complaint weekly average—indicating rapid establishment of unlicensed or non-compliant cannabis retailers in CD107, a potential enforcement gap.
evidence: 4 cannabis retailer complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (967% spike, z-score 5.21)
Suggests either new illicit retailers opening or neighbors reporting newly compliant retailers
No prior community board discussion or constituent escalation suggests a blind spot in neighborhood oversight
reporting_angles: Are these complaints about unlicensed retailers, licensed retailers with operational violations, or community objections to location/hours?
Interview OCME and NYPD about enforcement activity; locate the specific retailers or storefronts generating complaints

themes_detail.label: Hazardous Materials Alert
themes_detail.summary: Hazardous materials complaints tripled to 3 last week—a 1100% spike from the 0.2-complaint weekly average—a rare signal that warrants swift investigation into what toxic substances or unsafe conditions are being reported in residential areas.
evidence: 3 hazardous materials complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1100% spike, z-score 4.16)
Extremely rare baseline (0.2/week) makes any spike significant and concerning
No details on substance type or location; immediate follow-up needed
reporting_angles: File FOIL request for the 3 specific hazmat 311 complaints from last week—what substances, locations, and outcomes?
Contact NYC DEP and FDNY hazmat units about any concurrent incidents or environmental reports in CD107
